name: What does a full kitchen remodel include compared to a cosmetic refresh?

mainEntity.name: What does a full kitchen remodel include compared to a cosmetic refresh?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full kitchen remodel involves stripping the space down to the framing or subfloor to update the layout, mechanical systems, cabinetry, countertops, and finishes. Unlike a cosmetic refresh that only replaces cabinet doors or paint, a full remodel reconfigures structural and utility elements. At HH Remodeling LLC, we handle the complete scope from framing and drywall to finish carpentry, custom molding, and tile backsplashes. We coordinate the licensed plumbing and electrical sub-trades directly, so you work with a single lead contractor throughout the renovation. This approach is ideal if your current kitchen has poor workflow, outdated wiring, or worn structural surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full remodel strips the kitchen to framing to update layouts, plumbing, wiring, cabinets, and tile, whereas a cosmetic refresh only updates surface elements like paint or hardware.
